correctness.rationale: For iid uniform draws on n labels, conditioning on birthday time B=t leaves exactly n-t+1 unseen coupons, so C|B=t=t+sum_{r=1}^{n-t+1}Geom(r/n), with exceptional B=n+1 giving deterministic C=n. Coupling consecutive t using the same geometric increments gives strictly decreasing first-order stochastic order and negative covariance for nondecreasing transforms. Expressing B as indicators of initial unit discovery waits and summing independent geometric covariances gives the displayed exact negative double sum. Birthday survival product yields Rayleigh scaling, dominated Riemann sums give Cov(B,C)/sqrt(n)→-sqrt(pi/8), coupon variance n²π²/6 and birthday variance n(4-pi)/2 give the Pearson constant. The independent Rayleigh/Gumbel joint weak limit follows by coupling C to an independent complete geometric sum, with difference o_P(n). Verified exact covariance n=2,3,4,8 from separate rational formula. These finite checks are not the all-n proof.
